title: Gmail

credentials.how: Create an OAuth client in Google Cloud Console, enable the Gmail API, and mint an access token for gmail.readonly. Refresh the token outside the agent.

experts.title: Inbox triage
experts.job: Decides which messages need the reader, why, and writes the replies — without touching the mailbox.

gate: gmail.readonly is a restricted scope. For external users Google requires app verification plus a CASA security assessment, and an OAuth client left in Testing expires refresh tokens after 7 days.
dataRetention: Message bodies go to the model provider on every run. Do not persist them beyond the thread.
